content: jose 6.x: jwtVerify(jwt, secret, { issuer, audience, algorithms }) validates signature then claims; HMAC keys must be Uint8Array encoded secret of >=32 bytes for HS256; SignJWT exposes setIssuer/setAudience/setJti/setExpirationTime/setIssuedAt. For a single-issuer app HS256 with a strong secret is acceptable; RS256/EdDSA+JWKS only needed when multiple verifiers.
